input.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access/use rights to Company affiliates on written notice
input.comment: [Playbook] Our licence checklist requires affiliate coverage; Section 1.4 grants access and use rights to the Company alone, so we have added that the Company's affiliates may exercise those rights upon written notice to HDI. Successor transfer is already preserved by Section 10.3.

ops.text: Upon written notice to HDI identifying the entity, the Company's affiliates (any entity controlling, controlled by, or under common control with the Company) may exercise the Company's rights of access and use under this Section 1.4.
